title: Ezekiel's Symbolic Act: The Siege of Jerusalem
description: God commands the prophet Ezekiel to perform a dramatic symbolic act: He is to carve the city of Jerusalem onto a brick and build siege works against it, set up an iron griddle as an iron wall, and then lie on his left side for 390 days to bear the guilt of the House of Israel, and 40 days on his right side for the guilt of the House of Judah. In this way, he becomes a visible sign of the coming siege and judgment upon Jerusalem.
